answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit an identity polynomial over a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, while RLN rate-limits messages per epoch. For each valid proof, the agent evaluates the epoch polynomial and derives a one-time share. A duplicate message produces two shares at the same point; Shamir secret sharing then reconstructs the private key, enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus raven, ridge, and dawn aliases cannot multiply voting power.
